zh.name: 碎境
zh.safetyTitle: 先照顾好现实中的自己
zh.safety: 本应用仅供娱乐解压，请勿在真实世界模仿投掷易碎物品行为，请注意周边环境安全
zh.instruction: 手指触碰后左右滑动 · 捏取物品后挥手松开
zh.controller: 已检测到手柄正在使用。应用已切换为纯手势交互，请放下手柄，让双手进入追踪范围。
zh.hands: 等待双手进入追踪范围
zh.resetBody: 清空场景内所有碎片，并将全部投掷计数归零。
zh.loadError: 部分模型无法加载，其他物品仍可使用
zh.noPlane: 暂未读取到环境平面，请在系统中确认空间信息
zh.noHands: 未检测到双手，请将双手移入追踪范围
zh.previewNote: 概念预览：不执行手势追踪或物理模拟

en.name: Shatter Realm
en.safetyTitle: Take care of your real surroundings
en.safety: This app is for entertainment and stress relief only. Do not imitate throwing fragile objects in the real world. Stay aware of your surroundings.
en.shelf: Pick an object. Let it go.
en.instruction: Touch and swipe to browse · Pinch to grab, swing and release
en.controller: Active controller use detected. The app is now using hand interaction only. Set down your controllers and bring your hands into view.
en.resetBody: Remove all fragments and reset every throw count to zero.
en.loadError: Some models could not be loaded. Other objects are still available.
en.noPlane: No environment planes available. Check spatial data in system settings.
en.noHands: Hands not detected. Bring your hands into view.
en.previewNote: Concept preview: no hand tracking or physics simulation
